title: Compare battery and fleet views with NERV; contribute missing generic pieces to bricks
goal: Generic pieces bricks lacked are bricks PRs; the battery and fleet views are compared with NERV's FPV pack and the options written for the owner
acceptance: Each missing generic piece (bottom navigation bar if tabs did not fit, any other from F-008-T01) is a merged PR in voidbrain/bricks under its own rules, named here by number, and FPVBuddy uses the release with it

The battery view is compared with NERV's battery tab (nerv:F-130-T09, nerv:F-101); the record lists the options: a bricks pattern (generic parts only) or a later shared domain package with F-005's core, with what each would hold; fleet views are listed as not in FPVBuddy yet
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take FPVBuddy's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one or two small bricks components with review and release waits, plus a read of NERV's battery tab. Not a measurement.
